$comment: The autonomous-lane build envelope — the SINGLE source of truth for what an unattended Claude session may not change. Prose copies (CLAUDE.md, governor/SKILL.md, ship/SKILL.md, orient.md) cite this file rather than restating the list; restating it is how the wording drifted before (several copies dropped 'and hard to reverse' from CLAUDE.md's original). Enforced by scripts/envelope-scan.mjs via tests/arch/envelope.spec.ts.
$diffAwareComment: SUPERSEDED, removed 2026-09-17 (raised by Eric: 'envelope.json feels like a test against implementation; brittle and always breaking'). #852 (2026-08-29) built a diffAware/behaviorVerified exemption — a protected file could clear the hold per-diff via pure-insertion, safe token-level structural widening (#716/#858), or a passing registered invariant suite (scripts/envelope-widening.mjs, scripts/envelope-behavior.mjs). #928 (2026-08-30) then proved the stronger move: rather than keep a broad file gated and prove individual diffs safe, EXTRACT the actual sensitive capability into its own narrow file with no non-sensitive diff shape left to exempt — e.g. account-identity-gate.ts is the only thing still hard-gated in the trading-desk cluster; trade-service.ts/option-trade-service.ts/the Alpaca clients opened up entirely instead of being marked diffAware. Eric, 2026-08-30: 'dancing around protected areas is the wrong behavior... the solution is to remove the shit, not spray febreze to mask the smell.' No protected entry has used diffAware since #928 — confirmed zero `"diffAware": true` in this file before removal. The mechanism (~660 lines: envelope-widening.mjs, envelope-behavior.mjs, their specs, the option-ticket property-suite PoC) was deleted rather than kept as unexercised machinery for a pattern the house no longer reaches for; scripts/envelope-scan.mjs is pure path-matching plus a runtime-dependency check again. If a future protected file genuinely can't be narrowed by extraction, re-derive a proof mechanism for that specific case rather than reviving this one unread — the extraction pattern should be tried first.

protected.why: workflow files — high blast radius, and a lane that can edit its own trigger has no envelope at all
composite actions called by workflow files — same blast radius as the workflows that invoke them (#914)
the lanes' own instructions — self-modification is the one thing an envelope must never permit
dependency automation config
harness permissions and hooks
this file — a lane may not widen its own envelope
the gate itself — a lane that can edit its own gate's logic has no envelope at all
the gate's structural-widening helper — same reason as envelope-scan.mjs
the gate's behavior-verification helper (#852) — same reason as envelope-scan.mjs
auth — sessions, providers, the allowlist

the ONLY code allowed to turn a raw broker credential factory into a usable client (#928 slice 3) — trade-service.ts, option-trade-service.ts, and desk-gate.ts hold no raw factory and open up alongside this split

the ONLY code allowed to resolve a bot's live Alpaca credential for the internal cross-app bridge (#1180) — the first place a real broker secret ever crosses that bridge, same one-narrow-file precedent as account-identity-gate.ts
the invite gate — who gets into the shared universe
the coach's model dial (#928) — the one knob that changes the real per-token bill; round/token/throttle caps and the PROMPT stay open in feedback-coach-limits.ts and feedback-coach.ts
the companion's model dial (#928), mirroring feedback-coach-model.ts — same shared rate, same reasoning
hosting config — spend and deploy topology (fly.toml is the dashboard app, fly.bots.toml the bots app)
deploy topology — decides which pushes redeploy the bots app; widening its skip list silently strands bots on stale code
deploy topology — gates the bots rollback path; weakening it ships unverified bots releases
the deployed image
environment/credential files

$openOnPurpose: Deliberately NOT protected (Eric, 2026-08-22 — 'gate money-moving logic only'; sharpened 2026-08-29–30, #928 — 'the intent is to prevent people from changing things that explicitly belong to others... building features that everyone can use is community owned'; 'the correct idea [is] to abstract sensitive logic out so it can be fenced, this enables users to improve more parts of our application'; 'dancing around protected areas is the wrong behavior... the solution is to remove the shit, not spray febreze to mask the smell'): src/observatory/**, src/ui/**, src/three/**, everything that merely RENDERS trades, P/L, leaderboards or bot cards, AND, as of #928 across all three slices, src/engine/guards.ts, src/bots/account-guard.ts, src/trading/order-ticket.ts, src/trading/option-ticket.ts, src/playbooks/**, src/server/feedback-coach-limits.ts, src/companion/companion-limits.ts, src/server/desk-gate.ts, src/server/trade-service.ts, src/server/option-trade-service.ts, src/alpaca/alpaca-trading-client.ts, src/alpaca/alpaca-options-client.ts, and src/alpaca/credentials.ts — risk sizing, discipline rules, bot-account coordination, playbook authorship, the coach/companion's round·message·token·throttle caps, and now the ENTIRE desk-execution seam and the broker clients, none of which can reach another member's account or data, or change what model bills the real per-token rate. The honesty invariants (real tickers, truthful SIM/LIVE labels, paper-only) are a judgment stop stated in .github/prompts/feedback-build.md, not a path — no file list can enforce 'this flourish implies something false'. #928's story ends here: three files stay protected in this whole story, each because it is the one narrow, extractable place a real sensitive capability lives — src/server/account-identity-gate.ts (turning a raw broker-credential factory into a usable client), src/server/feedback-coach-model.ts and src/companion/companion-model.ts (the model dial that changes the real per-token bill) — never because a file is trading- or spend-shaped in general.
